integrity: The defining relative Rota-Baxter identities are reconstructed directly from the Leibniz bracket and dual regular representation. Two exact rational witnesses prove false-positive and false-negative behavior of the printed equation system. A standalone symbolic checker and finite-field branch enumeration replay every accepted claim.
scientific_limitations: The correction is established for arXiv:2101.04831v1; the complete journal text was not inspected, so a publication-stage correction cannot be excluded.
Only the nonzero equal-lower-right branch is fully reclassified; no complete corrected classification of all pairs in Example 2.3 is claimed.
The finite-field branch count assumes odd characteristic.
title: A two-sided correction to a relative Rota–Baxter system example
